# Whispers in the Court - the consequence queue.
# GENERATED by tools/gen_queue.py from courtbrain/actions.py - do not edit.
#
# 1622 consequences, 6 slots. The run file writes the slots;
# the confirming option of the event applies them, so its tooltip shows them.

votc_queue = {
	set_variable = { name = votc_q$slot$ value = $id$ }
}

# The years of a policy whose duration travels with it (the areas added later:
# their consequence reads var:votc_qy<slot>).
votc_queue_years = {
	set_variable = { name = votc_qy$slot$ value = $years$ }
}

# A page of chronicle waits a day on the calendar: its consequences have
# slots of their own, so an outcome in the meantime cannot overwrite them.
votc_apply_chronicle = {
	votc_apply_slot = { slot = c1 }
	votc_apply_slot = { slot = c2 }
	votc_apply_slot = { slot = c3 }
	votc_apply_slot = { slot = c4 }
	votc_apply_slot = { slot = c5 }
	votc_apply_slot = { slot = c6 }
	votc_queue_clear_chronicle = yes
}

# The option chosen in a story event: its own consequences only.
votc_apply_option = {
	votc_apply_slot = { slot = o$o$_1 }

	votc_apply_slot = { slot = o$o$_3 }
	votc_apply_slot = { slot = o$o$_4 }
	votc_queue_clear_options = yes
}
